functions.name: verify_customer
functions.description: Verify the caller before any confidential account information is discussed. Use only after the caller supplies the requested factor.

idLast4.description: Last four digits of the loan account number or PAN.

functions.name: get_account_details
functions.description: Retrieve the verified caller's account facts. The server rejects this before verification.

functions.name: log_promise_to_pay
functions.description: Log an explicit payment promise after the caller confirms a future date and amount.

ptpDate.description: Promised payment date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

functions.name: send_payment_link
functions.description: Send a payment link only after log_promise_to_pay succeeded.

channel.description: The verified caller's requested delivery channel.

functions.name: log_dispute
functions.description: Record a verified caller's dispute before escalation.

notes.description: Brief neutral summary; omit sensitive credentials.

functions.name: escalate_to_agent
functions.description: Create a human-agent ticket for a verified caller when judgment or reconciliation is required.

summary.description: Brief summary without DOB, ID digits, or unneeded PII.

functions.name: mark_disposition
functions.description: Log the final call disposition immediately before ending a call.

functions.name: record_do_not_call
functions.description: Immediately suppress future calls when the caller requests no further calls.

functions.name: record_wrong_person
functions.description: End safely when the person answering states they are not the intended customer.
